title: Refine translated parameters to conditional κ = 5.7114918e-6
body:
Using the remaining bit-moment slack in #21 with exact rational parameters gives

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=\frac{57114918}{10^{13}}=5.7114918\times10^{-6}.$$

This increases the asymptotic exponent saving by **3.86419% over #21**. Later results now give stronger bounds; this completed refinement and its source pins are preserved for dependent work. It is not a practical runtime claim.

### Exact refinement and compatible assembly

The finite networks, bases, complex phase construction, precision guard and analytic/tape hypotheses remain unchanged. The bit saving is `2284609773/200000000000000`, with exact moment gap greater than `1e-17`. All **29 strict interface constraints and seven margins** pass; the final absorption gap exceeds `1e-14`.

The next `1e-15` bit-saving grid point fails the retained sufficient envelope. This is a scoped limit of that enclosure, not an impossibility result for the true moment or other constructions. The contribution includes a dependency argument, exact certificate and reproducible patch against the pinned #21 assembly proof.

### Review and validation

- **Full repository rerun passed:** `make verify`, including **172 tests**, scalar producer reconstruction, inherited certificates and **19 patch-application checks**.
- The final hash-pinned refinement verifier and both negative controls passed.
- Regenerated certificates and patches reproduce without a diff; whitespace checks passed.
- Independent Standards and Spec/arithmetic reviews found **no findings**, including the final source-pinning change. The latter reconstructed all 35 logarithm enclosures, the rational envelope and seven margins.

This PR is ready for review. The six-file increment starts from #21 commit `5ba6cf0bfb68f2be8d15610e7972207c50254d6a`; pending predecessors appear in the main-branch diff. Local verification used Python 3.14.8 and does not claim unrun CI environments passed. No PDF was generated. Exact finite checks do not formally verify the full multiplication theorem.

Deslop and independent code review were applied. Blast-radius and codebase-design were unnecessary because shared interfaces and inherited code remain unchanged; automatic retro was skipped for insufficient session history.
